meta.name: opencode-qa
meta.description: QA opencode itself, per case: verify the CLI/terminal (opencode run, db, serve, export), prove a specific plugin hook/action/event fired via the SSE event stream, smoke-test the TUI under tmux, and investigate sessions in opencode's SQLite DB by id, title/name, or message text. Ships tested helper scripts (each with a --self-test) plus per-domain references. Use whenever someone wants to QA, smoke-test, verify, or debug opencode's CLI, HTTP server, plugin hooks/events, or TUI, or to find/inspect opencode sessions in the database. Triggers: opencode qa, qa opencode, test opencode, verify opencode hook, opencode session db, find opencode session by id/name/text, opencode tui test, opencode server health, opencode event stream.

copy.tagline: 验证 AI 编程助手的命令、界面与数据记录是否正常
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要验证 opencode 的命令、插件触发及会话数据是否正常
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on or use an AI coding assistant and need to verify its CLI, plugin events, or session history

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能为 opencode 本身做质检:跑 CLI 命令做检查、查 SQLite 里的会话、探测 SSE 事件/插件钩子、在 tmux 下冒烟测试 TUI,并汇报自检结果。
howto.when: 当你想测试、验证或排查 opencode 本身的 CLI、插件事件、数据库会话等,或说出「opencode qa」「test opencode」「opencode session db」等时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一遍 opencode QA 脚本的自检。
查一下 opencode 数据库里标题含「auth refactor」的会话。
say.note: 会读取本地会话库并列出匹配结果。

say.text: 验证 opencode 的 SSE 事件流是否正常。
say.note: 会连接事件流并报告能否收到事件。

howto.what_en: Claude runs bundled helper scripts to QA opencode: checks CLI commands, queries SQLite sessions, probes SSE/plugin events, and smoke-tests the TUI under tmux. Each script has --self-test; DB scans are read-only and any run that spawns opencode is sandboxed.
howto.when_en: When you want to QA/debug opencode itself (CLI, plugin events, TUI, etc.) or find sessions in its SQLite DB; saying 'opencode qa', 'test opencode', or 'opencode session db' also triggers it.

say_en.text: Run the opencode QA self-tests for me.
say_en.note: Runs each script with --self-test and reports results.

say_en.text: Find opencode sessions with title “auth refactor”.
say_en.note: Queries the local SQLite DB and returns matches.

say_en.text: Check whether the opencode SSE event stream works.
say_en.note: Connects and reports whether events arrive.
